belay.P2: At the top of the narrow chimney, about 25 feet above the chockstone.

belay.2: A small stance just above the offwidth, with a horizontal crack to stand on.
belay.3: A slung block on the right in the dihedral, about 30 feet under the headwall, before the route pushes left.
belay.4: A sloping ledge reached by moving left on good cracks, directly under the steep thin-hands crack.
belay.5: A small ledge with a bolted anchor at the top of the crack, under the last offwidth section.

belay.P1-2: In a recessed spot at the base of the next crack and corner system, reached by climbing the cracks.
belay.P3: On a small ledge just above the roof, once you have pulled through it.
belay.P13: On a ledge up on the crest of the buttress, at the top of the corner.
belay.P18: On a small stance at the top of the long series of thin cracks.
